title: The Scheduler That Completed Without Delivering Evidence
claim: A scheduler's recorded completion does not establish successful downstream evidence intake, persistence, or independent recoverability.

sourceLocators.observation: Recorded status completed; task result PARTIAL COMPLETION / DRAFT SYNC PENDING; does not establish Site intake.
Additive candidate custody permitted in existing draft PR #66; no automatic admission.

evidence.scope: Scheduler metadata reported one completed run, not successful intake.
Site source-management tool was unavailable in the recovery session; no intake was executed in that session.
Whether an independent downstream intake ever succeeded for the referenced scheduler run.
Source revision, script SHA-256 checks, intake, persistence, independent version readback and downstream consequence closure.

firstUnsupportedArrow: Recorded scheduler COMPLETED → downstream evidence intake completed.
counterevidenceAndAlternatives: The scheduler may have executed correctly and reported a partial result; scheduler malfunction is not established.
Unavailable Site tools in this session do not establish that the Site failed, that stored evidence was lost, or that another authorized execution environment lacks access.
A later successful manual intake would not prove the earlier scheduled run performed that intake.

reproduction.environment: Existing private Site source-management environment, unavailable in this session
requiredProcedure: Open the existing Site source, without creating a replacement.
Read SCHEDULED-INTAKE.md and compare exact SHA-256 values for both pinned scripts before execution.
Run one bounded intake only if both hashes match.
Record changed/no-change outcome and any source commit and undeployed draft version.
Independently read back exact resulting source/version receipts.
For scheduler-origin proof, correlate a separate subsequent scheduled run to its own receipts.
reproduction.expectedPositive: Exact source, verified hashes, intake outcome and independently readable source/version receipt linked to the correct execution.
reproduction.negative: Completed scheduler status with no downstream source/version receipt.
reproduction.defeatingObservation: Independently retrieved, run-correlated intake and persistence receipts establish the intended outcome for the claimed run.

consequences.beneficial: An explicit delivery receipt could prevent false promotion of incomplete evidence.
consequences.harmful: Unverified task completion could conceal stale dashboards or missing intake if a downstream consumer relies on it.
consequences.ambiguous: The actual downstream effect is unknown; no loss, harm or Site malfunction is established.

reversibility: Unknown; no evidence loss demonstrated. No state change made by this candidate.

externalStop.authority: Human disposition reserved; machine cannot admit or certify this record.

reopenConditions: Supported private Site source access and exact hash verification
A completed bounded intake with source/version readback
Independent correlation of a later scheduled execution to downstream evidence receipts
humanTranslationKey: The delivery truck returned to the warehouse. Its dashboard says the route is complete. Nobody has checked whether the package arrived.
sigmaLine: A completed task is not a delivered consequence.
provenanceLimit: This is an interactive, human-requested repository custody operation, not an authentic scheduled-run deposit or independent validation.
